From: Lesley Groff

On Nov 28, 2016, at 2:52 PM, james ce I personal genius < 
wrote: 
Hi Lesley, 
The Epson Espression Premium XP-830 you note below would work fine, but it is an inkjet, which means the 
printer is discounted because you'll pay more for ever-empty ink cartridges over the life of the printer. 
Amazon has it, with an ink multi-pak for $170 https://www.amazon.com/Epson-Expression-Premium-Wireless-
Multi ack/dp/B0179FL1Q01 
I'd recommend considering the HP LaserJet Pro M277dw Wireless All-in-One Color Printer, which is 
slightly smaller physical size (16.5" x 16.4" x 12.7" vs Epson's 19.1" x 16.8" x 10.4"), but laser so the toners 
will last much longer making it cheaper to own over the life of the printer. 
Amazon's price is $280 https://www.amazon.com/HP-LaserJet-M277dw-Wireless-Printer/dp/BOOTVACKEE/ 
Ipqffrey is buying, I'd order one of each of the high-capacity toner cartridges too, to have spares on hand: 
Black - https://www.amazon.com/FIP-CF400X-Original-LaserJet-Cartridge/dp/B00UBMO61G/ 
Cyan - https://www.amazon.corri/HP-CF401X-Original-Laserlet-Cartridge/dp/B00UBMO7RY/ 
Yellow - https://www.amazon.corn/HP-CF402X-Original-LaserJet-Cartridge/dp/B00UBMO97W/ 
Magenta - https://www.amazon.com/HP-CF403X-Original-LaserJet-Cartridge/dp/B00UBMOBN4/ 
Both support AirPrint (printing from iPhone / iPad, etc), but I'd recommend installing the drivers from Apple 
and not from the CD included in the box (those CDs are always horribly out of date). 
The Apple Epson drivers are available at https://support.apple.com/kb/DL1792
The Apple HP drivers are available at https://support.apple.com/kb/DL1888
Once you have the printer set up & plugged in place of your recently deceased printer, install the relevant 
driver above and then add the printer via System Preferences > Printers. It should see the printer automatically, 
you'll just need to change the driver to use from the AirPrint driver to the installed Apple driver. 
I know that last bit sounds daunting, but it should be obvious at that moment. If you get overwhelmed or stuck, 
I'll have you install an app that allows me to control your screen so I can take care of the software side 
remotely. 
,James Ce, your Personal Genius, 
http://personalgenius.us
